defects.description: The limit check in `allow` uses `>` instead of `>=`, so it admits one event beyond `max_events` per window.
paraphrases: Off-by-one in `allow`: a client can send `max_events + 1` requests before being throttled.
The rate limiter permits one too many events because the comparison should be `>=`, not `>`.
`len(self._events) > self.max_events` under-counts by one; the guard lets an extra event through each window.
defects.rationale: Real (admits max_events+1), findable from the diff alone, and distinct from the other seeded defects.

defects.description: `utilization` divides by `self.max_events` with no guard, raising ZeroDivisionError when `max_events == 0`.
paraphrases: A `RateLimiter` built with `max_events=0` crashes in `utilization()` due to division by zero.
Missing zero check before the division in `utilization`.
`len(self._events) / self.max_events` is unguarded against a zero denominator.
defects.rationale: Real (ZeroDivisionError on a legal-looking config), findable, uniquely describable.

defects.description: `cutoff` is computed with `+` instead of `-`, placing it in the future so every event is evicted and the limiter never throttles.
paraphrases: Sign error: `now + self.window_seconds` should subtract; as written the sliding window retains nothing.
The window cutoff moves forward in time, so `allow` always returns True regardless of load.
`cutoff = now + self.window_seconds` inverts the window boundary and disables rate limiting entirely.
defects.rationale: Real (limiter is a no-op), findable from the arithmetic, distinct from the off-by-one defect.

defects.description: `from_config` passes constructor arguments in the wrong order, swapping `max_events` and `window_seconds`.
paraphrases: The classmethod builds the limiter with `window_seconds` and `max_events` transposed versus `__init__`'s signature.
`cls(cfg["window_seconds"], cfg["max_events"])` maps the config values onto the wrong parameters.
defects.rationale: Real (config is silently mis-applied), findable by comparing to the constructor signature in the same diff.
